items.title: Smart Resort Management System
items.summary: A Java-based resort management application designed to simplify guest services and internal resort operations. It provides separate functions for guests and administrators, covering room bookings, guest information, employee accounts, shifts and resort-related services.

items: View booking bills and pay them
View food and diet-related room service information
Monitor guest registrations and login activity
Monitor employee accounts and login activity
Change the administrator's own password, and manage or reset employee passwords
Assign and modify employee shifts, and adjust or cancel them when an employee has a scheduling problem or leave
Manage room-service and food-service employee assignments

items.contribution: I contributed to the guest-facing functionality and the administrative section, particularly employee account management, password management, and shift assignment and scheduling. This was a team project, and I worked with my teammates throughout.

items.title: AI-Based Personal Fitness Assistant
items.summary: An AI-based personal fitness assistant that helps users monitor their daily lifestyle, food consumption, calorie intake, physical activities and general health-related information. Its feedback is general informational fitness and lifestyle guidance. It is not a medical diagnosis or treatment tool.

items: Daily calorie intake monitoring and estimated calorie requirements
Recording user-provided health information, including blood pressure readings when provided
Analysis of recorded information with instant general feedback and lifestyle suggestions
Daily activity summaries and weekly progress reports
Pointing out areas where habits could improve, with general fitness and lifestyle recommendations

items.contribution: This was my individual academic project. I independently designed and developed the application, including daily activity tracking, nutrition monitoring, health-related information management, feedback and report generation.

steps: Enter meals, activities and health information
